notes.title: Update January 13, 2022.
notes.notes: -This build is updated with Unity New Input System to support various gamepad better on various OS.

notes.title: Patch November 29, 2021
notes.notes:
-Mouse cursor will be hidden if player use the controller, and reappear when player touch the mouse.
-Game will be paused when player turn on the Steam overlay.
-Edited 1 line text on Japanese and English version.
-Fixed the windowed mode setting, so if player switch from Full screen to Windowed, the resolution won't be the same with the full screen resolution.
-Make the window size resizable.

notes.title: Update 2021 July 23th
notes.notes: Fixed the wrong Reset button image from X button to Y button for specific controller type.

notes.title: Update Notes for May 11th 2021
notes.notes: Slight controller adjustment in popup menu.

notes.title: Update Patch 5/9/2021
notes.notes: Adjusted the new Map UI so the map button's text won't cover the fries icon when the button is hovered.

notes.title: Update for May 8th 2021
notes.notes: This update will fix the controller glitches within the gallery mode, and the interfaces, such as the map menu or the selections are improved to make player easier to notice which item is being selected.
